title: Program Start and the Program Year Filter Credit — Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs Training Note
content:
Training note for the client services desk on when a program under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs starts and how its filter credit is held.

**Rule.** A program starts when the owner's acceptance of the quote is recorded against it. At the start of each program year the program is credited with the tier's included filter sets for each covered unit, and the credit does not carry forward at the year end. Where the tier changes the filters itself, the sets are consumed as they are fitted; where the tier only supplies them, the sets are consumed as they are delivered and the owner's own staff fit them. A unit added mid-year is credited its sets pro rata by whole months remaining, and a unit removed leaves its undelivered sets in the credit for the rest of the year rather than being refunded at once.

### Questions answered

**On what record does a program start?** On the owner's acceptance of the quote as recorded against that program in the company's air quality intake records. An acceptance the caller reports, but which the records do not show against the program, is not a start; the program stays a quote until the acceptance is on record.

**How many sets are credited at the start of a program year?** The tier's included filter sets per covered unit multiplied by the program's covered units. On hypothetical inputs, a tier that includes 4 sets per covered unit and a program covering 7 units yields a credit of 28 sets for the year; a tier that includes 12 sets per covered unit on the same 7 units yields 84 sets.

**What happens to sets still in credit when the program year ends?** Nothing carries forward. The credit for the new program year is the fresh credit for that year, whatever remained at the end of the last.

**When is a set consumed?** At a tier at which the company changes the filters, when the set is fitted at the site; at a tier at which the program only supplies the sets, when the set is delivered to the site, the owner's own staff fitting it afterwards. The filter sets still owed to the site are the sets credited less the sets consumed.

**How is a unit added mid-year credited?** With the tier's sets per unit reduced pro rata by the whole months remaining in the program year. On hypothetical inputs, a tier that includes 6 sets per covered unit and a unit added with 6 whole months of a 12-month year remaining is credited 3 sets, 6 multiplied by 6 twelfths; a unit added with 4 whole months remaining is credited 2 sets, 6 multiplied by 4 twelfths.

**How is a unit removed mid-year treated?** Its undelivered sets stay in the program's credit for the rest of the year; they are not refunded at once.

### The filter credit as the records show it

The program's filter credit is the number of filter sets the program still owes the site this program year. It rises at activation, at renewal and on each crediting of sets, and falls as each set is consumed; the figure the desk reads on the program is the running result of those entries.
